scope: Local completed follow-up: change-tracking deletion geometry and isolated standalone qualification selection
sourceIdentity: Commit/tree pairs identify the captured local Git sources; no new hosted run or publication mapping is asserted.

failures: 64 KiB paste undo discards deleted touched lines and bounds subsequent overview source reads
repeated paste undo redo cycles do not accumulate obsolete markers or overview reads
deletion ending exactly at a line start retains the surviving old-end marker at its new line
deletion through EOF and whole-document replacement leave only surviving line candidates
LF-only deletion within CRLF preserves marked prefix and suffix lines without shifting trailing markers
LF insertion after CR joins one delimiter and keeps trailing markers at their existing line
splitting and rejoining CRLF maps all surviving source marks through exact snapshot geometry

aggregation.rule: The baseline reuses the same 16 change-tracking cases. Do not add its counts to the 69-case cohort or to prior full-area/hosted a6 counts.

provenance.rawCopies: tests.log and summary.json are byte-for-byte copies of root-produced artifacts; each raw artifact is hashed above.
provenance.baselinePreparation: Only the exact candidate change-tracking test was temporarily copied untracked onto the unchanged baseline. Root verified and removed that authored copy before merging; unrelated untracked files were preserved.
provenance.packageResolution: Captured summaries record real editor, text and syntax package roots in p16-integration, sourceUnchanged and trackedCleanAfter. They also preserve the complete observed untracked-file inventory.

qualificationLimits: These are local Node executions, not browser/GUI, hosted CI, platform or native application qualification.
The overview regression asserts candidate and source-read counts through production ChangeTracking/OverviewRuler with a DOM construction double; it does not measure paint latency.
The standalone cases validate qualification selection and orchestration contracts; no standalone browser was launched by this cohort.
The original a6 relative undo-to-paint failures remain unresolved by these functional results. No latency cause, measured speedup, threshold waiver or new performance result is claimed.
No tests, builds, checks or benchmarks were executed to assemble this evidence archive.
